title: ShikigamiApi
description: Bundle of the IPC/API payload types used by Studio and MCP tools.

Scenario.title: Scenario
Scenario.description: A scenario: the unit that AI clients, Studio and the Runtime share.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editors. Ignored by Shikigami.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the scenario file format.

revision.description:
Monotonic revision, incremented by every committed edit. Used for
optimistic concurrency between Studio, MCP clients and the CLI.

settings.description: Scenario-wide defaults for error handling, timeouts and retries.

ScenarioId.description: Identifier of a scenario. Also used as its file name in the store.

secret.description: Secret values are masked in logs, events and run records.

oneOf.description: Supplied by the caller when the run starts.
Returned to the caller when the run finishes.
Both supplied and returned.

Step.description: A single step. Control-flow and action steps share this shape.

id.description: Stable unique ID. Omit when adding a step; Core assigns one.

name.description: Display label (Japanese is fine). Purely informational.

params.description:
Type-specific parameters, validated against the step type's schema.
String values may contain `{{ expression }}` templates.

blocks.description: Child step lists of control-flow steps, keyed by block name.

disabled.description: Disabled steps are skipped by the Runtime but kept in the scenario.

onError.description: What to do when the step still fails after retries.

saveAs.description: Variable that receives the step's output value.

meta.description:
Free-form metadata (Studio layout hints, AI provenance such as the UI
element a selector was derived from). Never interpreted by the Runtime.

StepId.description: Identifier of a step. Unique within a scenario and stable across edits.

maxAttempts.description: Total attempts including the first one (1 = no retry).

backoffMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the delay after each failed attempt.

oneOf.description: Stop the run (or hand control to the enclosing `control.try`).
Record the error in `lastError` and continue with the next step.

defaultTimeoutMs.description: Default per-step timeout in milliseconds (30 s when omitted).

oneOf.description: Inserts a step (and its children). Missing IDs are generated.
Removes a step and all of its children.
Adds or replaces (by name) a variable declaration.

index.description: Position in the variable list when adding; ignored when replacing.

oneOf.description: Replaces the whole step tree (bulk edits by AI, imports).

Position.description: Where a step lives (or should be inserted).

parentId.description: Parent control-flow step; omit for the top level.

index.description: Index in the target list (after removing the moved step). Omit to append.

StepPatch.description:
Partial update of a step. Absent fields are left unchanged; for optional
fields, an explicit `null` clears the value.

params.description: JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7386) applied to `params`: keys set to `null` are removed.

validation.description:
Full validation of the new revision. Drafts may contain errors;
they must be fixed before the scenario can run.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the scenario document.

hint.description: How to fix it, written for AI clients (and shown to humans in Studio).

description.description: Description written for both humans and AI clients.

blocks.description: Child blocks allowed on this step (empty for action steps).

hasOutput.description: Whether the step produces a value that `saveAs` can capture.

expressionParams.description: Params whose string value is an expression (not a template).

bindsVariables.description: Params that declare a variable name (introduced into scope).

examples.description:
Complete, valid step objects showing typical use (IDs omitted). AI
clients get them from `get_step_schema` and can copy them.

secretParams.description:
Params that may take a registered secret,
`{ "secret": "<name>", "field": "password" }`, instead of text.
Secrets are rejected everywhere else.

defaultTimeoutMs.description:
Timeout when the step sets none (takes precedence over the
scenario's default), for steps that wait on people (manual login).

BlockDef.description: Named child block of a control-flow step.

RiskLevel.description: Risk level used by the permission layer (MCP approval, allow-lists).

oneOf.description: No side effects outside the run (variables, logs, control flow).
Interacts with applications or pages (clicks, typing, navigation).
May destroy data or reach outside the machine (file delete, downloads, process kill).

revision.description: Revision of the scenario after this change.

summary.description: The author's own explanation of the change (an AI's `summary`).

stepIds.description: Steps the change added, changed, moved or removed.

Actor.description: Who made a change. Recorded in history and the audit journal.

name.description: Client name, e.g. the MCP client's reported name.

ChangeEvent.description: Notification sent to in-process listeners after every committed change.

ErrorPayload.description: Serializable error shape returned over IPC / MCP.

name.description: Short name, e.g. "v1" or "本番リリース".

note.description: What changed or why this version matters.

ScenarioVersion.description: One named snapshot of a scenario.

number.description: Per-scenario sequence number (1, 2, …). This is how versions are referenced.

uid.description: Globally unique ID; keeps versions apart when bundles are imported.

revision.description: Scenario revision the snapshot was taken from.

VersionSummary.description: Listing entry for versions (no scenario body).

identical.description: True when the contents are the same (names, variables, steps, settings).

scenario.description: Scenario-level fields: name, description, tags, settings.

DiffSide.description: Which side of a comparison: a version number, or the current content.

version.description: Version number; absent for the current content.

StepChange.description:
One step-level difference. Added and removed subtrees are reported once,
at their top step (`stepCount` includes the children).

StepLocation.description: Where a step sits: top level (`parentId` absent) or a parent's block.

ScenarioBundle.description: File format for moving a scenario (and its versions) between workspaces.

subscenarios.description:
Every scenario `scenario` calls (directly or through others), without
versions, so the bundle runs on its own.

ImportOutcome.description: Result of importing a bundle or scenario file.

versionsAdded.description: Versions from the bundle that were added (already present ones are skipped).

subscenarios.description: The bundle's sub-scenarios and what happened to each.

validation.description:
Full validation of the new revision. Drafts may contain errors;
they must be fixed before the scenario can run.

ImportedSubscenario.description: One sub-scenario of an imported bundle.

SubscenarioImport.description: What importing a bundle did with one of its sub-scenarios.

oneOf.description: It was not in the workspace and was added with the same ID.
It existed and was updated (`onConflict: "update"`).
It existed and was left as it is.

ExtractOutcome.description: Result of moving steps into a new sub-scenario.

subscenario.description: The new scenario holding the steps.

caller.description: The calling scenario, with the steps replaced by one `scenario.call`.

ImportConflict.description: What to do when an imported scenario's ID already exists.

oneOf.description:
Apply the imported content to the existing scenario (one undoable
edit) and add the bundle's versions that are not there yet.
Import as a new scenario with a new ID.

WorkspaceInfo.description: Where a workspace keeps its data, for display and diagnostics.

localRoot.description: Undo history, run records and audit logs of this PC.

ChangeNote.description: What the author of a change says about it (MCP edit tools).

summary.description: Why the change was made, in the author's words. Kept in the journal.

observations.description:
Observations (screens looked at with inspect_* / test_step) the change
is based on. They are linked to the new revision and its steps.

ObservationId.description: Identifier of a screen an AI looked at (review evidence).

ReviewTimeline.description: What to review: the changes since the last approval and their evidence.

sinceRevision.description:
Changes and evidence after this revision are listed (by default the
last approved revision, or 0).

openFeedback.description:
The latest review when it sent the scenario back and nobody approved
it since: what the AI still has to address.

evidence.description: Test runs, observations and reviews, oldest first.

oneOf.description: A run an AI started over MCP to test `revision`.

version.description: Named version the run's content matched.

oneOf.description: An observation named by the edit that created `revision`.

RunId.description: Identifier of a single scenario execution.

ReviewVerdict.description: A human's verdict on a revision.

oneOf.description: Sent back to the AI (差し戻し) with a reason.

StepNote.description: A note on one step in a review.

ChangeRecord.description: One change in a review timeline (a journal entry without its ops).

revision.description: The revision that was reviewed; must still be the current one.

reason.description: Why it was sent back (required for `rejected`) or a remark.

ObservationContent.description: An observation with the contents of its files, for Studio.

treeFile.description: File name of the UI tree (`tree.txt`) in the observation's folder.

notes.description: What was cut or left out to keep the size down.

linked.description: Revisions whose edits named this observation as their basis.
